name: The Gables
use: Upper-division and 19+ apartments in five buildings (A, B, C, N, S), 965 students
builtText: A/B/C built June 1990–Aug 1991 (dedicated Oct 17, 1991); N and S later (date unconfirmed)
statusNote: Five buildings (A, B, C, N, S)

renovations.what: 'Summer Slammer': Gables A, B and C gutted and refitted in 68 days (101 suites, 1,134 rooms): new carpet, lighting, flooring, kitchen cabinets and appliances, counters, toilets/showers, vanities and paint (JM Coull with Harriman)

facts.text: The original three towers of four-to-six-person apartments were designed by Sasaki Associates, built by Suffolk Construction between June 1990 and August 1991, and dedicated October 17, 1991.
Today there are five buildings: A (197), B (177), C (197), N (164) and S (230 students), at 40 Gables Way.
Apartments are fully furnished; the complex has elevators, on-site parking (permit required) and a mailroom in B tower.
In summer 2014 JM Coull refitted 101 suites (1,134 rooms) in Gables A, B and C in 68 days.

verdict: Sasaki's 1991 brick apartment towers with tall gables and arched passages in the woods; furnished apartments with kitchens, refitted in 2014.
notes: One record covers all notunh parts (Gables A, B, C, N, S and the Community Building). The NEREJ article is undated in my copy (search results placed it in Sept 2014); old row said 2014, consistent with EnviroVantage's 'Summer Slammer'. N/S architect (old row: DiMella Shaffer) and build date (~2007) NOT confirmed this pass. Old row's 'Her Campus 2014' not re-verified. Photos: tall red-brick blocks (five to six storeys) with gabled dormers and steep roofs, arched entries and glazed stair bays, set along brick paths in woods; solid but bulky. Licensed photos (Flickr CC BY 2.0, 2018, student journalism account): tall red-brick towers with gabled dormers, arched entries and glazed stair bays along brick paths in the woods; solid but bulky. Account owner is a UNH journalism class ('UNHDigitalSandbox'); the photos are CC BY on Flickr, so they qualify, but the judge may want to double-check that they're acceptable.
judgeNotes: Photos show better-than-average brick massing. Interior 5 on student comments about dated finishes. Condition 6: the 2014 refit was cosmetic, and the towers are 35 years old.
